statement: Sign a batch only after it simulates successfully at the head, at the final signed budget, sized from the applyBatch self-call gas plus a named margin.

layers.arrival: owed: spec thread, next Arrival page (id not in a name yet)
layers.quint: owed: spec thread, new Quint branch (id not in a name yet)
layers.contract: n/a: signing after a simulation is the planner's duty; the chain's gas behaviour is J5 and F16
layers.rig: owed: test rig (a walk predicate for this rule; none is named yet)

killers.name: R-SIMULATE nothing is signed before the Host has answered a simulation of the exact batch
R-SIMULATE the final simulation runs at the final budget (a gasleft() reader answers by budget)
R-SIMULATE never sign above the chain's transaction gas cap: split instead
R-SIMULATE reaches seal: nothing is signed before the Host has simulated the batch
R-SIMULATE gas numbers are the deployed contract's
R-SIMULATE a batch that would revert is held: nothing is journaled, nothing is sent
R-SIMULATE the treasury holds each token's reserve and the whole debt of its three limbs
R-SIMULATE a call that succeeds with no refusal event has room: the gas it used
R-SIMULATE a call that reverts is a revert, with the node's own reason
R-SIMULATE BatchFailed and DisputeOpSkipped refuse the batch though the call succeeded
R-SIMULATE the call is made from the key's address at the head, with the gas limit it is given
R-SIMULATE a simulation with no call, or a node that is down, is a fault and never a revert
